note: Development briefs: every iteration of the engine runs on these, never on eval/briefs.json, which stays frozen for measurement. One per stratum of register, density and chart.

briefs.brief: A single page announcing that a neighbourhood bakery is opening a second shop. The news in one headline, a short paragraph on why this street, the opening date, and a way to sign up for the launch morning.
A one-screen page from a cycling club marking its hundredth group ride. One headline, a sentence of thanks, one chart of riders per month over the club's first year, and a link to join.
A page introducing an independent bookshop's translation prize. What the prize is for, how books are chosen, the three judges with a line about each, and how publishers enter.

A public page from a water utility explaining a summer hosepipe ban. Why it was needed, one chart of reservoir levels against the usual range, what is and is not allowed, and when it will be reviewed.

A long-form page from an architecture practice on how it retrofits old schools. An opening argument, four sections on structure, light, heat and people, a short case study, and a closing note on cost.

A community food bank's annual report page. A letter from the chair, sections on volunteers, donors and partners, a chart of parcels given out by month, a chart of where donations came from, and plans for next year.
A password reset page: a field for the email address, one action to send the reset link, a note on how long the link lasts, and a link back to sign in.
A single queue view in a support tool: the number of open tickets, the median wait, one chart of tickets opened per hour today, and an action to take the next ticket.
An API key management page: a list of keys with name, created date, last used and scope, an action to create a key with a scope choice, and a revoke action that asks for confirmation.
A monthly cost summary for a cloud account: total spend against budget, one chart of daily spend this month, the five most expensive services in a short list, and a link to set alerts.
A release checklist page for an engineering team: twenty items grouped into build, test, security and launch, each with an owner, a status and a due date, plus filters by owner and status.
A delivery fleet dashboard: vans on the road, on-time rate and fuel used today, a chart of deliveries completed by hour, a chart of late deliveries by depot, and a table of vans needing maintenance.
